description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseConfigField' which provides UI components and logic for configuration fields in a Swing-based Java application, including methods for requesting initial values, processing incoming data, sending commands, and creating user interface components.

classes.name: BaseConfigField
classes.description: An abstract class providing UI components and logic for interacting with configuration fields in a Swing application, including methods for requesting initial values, handling data, and creating UI.

methods.name: BaseConfigField
methods.description: Constructor initializing the field and UI components, setting tooltip for status.

methods.name: requestInitialValue
methods.description: Requests the initial value of the configuration field once the connection is established.

methods.name: processInitialValue
methods.description: Processes the initial configuration data received from the device.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement to load the configuration value.

methods.name: onValueArrived
methods.description: Updates the status label to indicate the value has arrived.

methods.name: sendValue
methods.description: Sends a new value command to the device and updates the status indicator.

methods.name: createUi
methods.description: Creates the UI panel layout with label, control, and status indicator.

methods.name: getByteBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a ByteBuffer wrapping the specified range from the ConfigurationImage, with proper byte order.
